protocol_type: Packetized embedded-display protocol with two transports. The Main Link is a uni-directional micro-packet video stream (Transfer Units + MSA, 8b/10b coded, embedded clock) to a single internal panel. The AUX channel is a bidirectional half-duplex request/reply transaction protocol (Manchester-II, ~1 Mbps) carrying native AUX accesses to the DPCD (including the eDP-specific block), I2C-over-AUX (EDID), backlight control, PSR control, and link-training control.

channels.name: Main Link (ML_Lane0..3)
channels.description: 1/2/4 self-clocked AC-coupled differential lanes; 8b/10b at RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3; embedded clock recovered by the panel during training; carries the micro-packet video stream.

channels.name: AUX CH (AUX+/AUX-)
channels.description: Manchester-II bi-phase differential pair at ~1 Mbps; native AUX request/reply transactions into DPCD + eDP-specific block, I2C-over-AUX EDID, backlight-over-AUX, and PSR control.

channels.name: Hot Plug Detect (HPD)
channels.description: Indicates presence; a short pulse (IRQ_HPD) signals link-status-change / PSR-state-change events.

request.length_field: bytes minus one (0..15 -> 1..16 bytes per transaction)
request.framing: SYNC preamble (consecutive zeros) + START/STOP delimiting the Manchester-coded payload

dpcd_regions.name: Receiver Capability
dpcd_regions.fields: DPCD_REV, MAX_LINK_RATE, MAX_LANE_COUNT, MAX_DOWNSPREAD, training-pattern / FEC / DSC capabilities

dpcd_regions.name: eDP-specific DPCD block
dpcd_regions.fields: eDP_DPCD_REV, eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP (ASSR / Fast Link Training / OUI), eDP_GENERAL_CAP (PSR / backlight), backlight registers (EDP_BACKLIGHT_MODE_SET / EDP_BACKLIGHT_BRIGHTNESS / EDP_PWMGEN_BIT_COUNT / EDP_BACKLIGHT_FREQ_SET), PSR registers (PSR_ENABLE / PSR_CONFIGURATION / PSR_STATUS / PSR2_ENABLE / SU region / RFB control)

i2c_over_aux.purpose: tunnel I2C transactions over AUX to reach the panel EDID
i2c_over_aux.mot_bit: Middle-Of-Transaction bit chains a multi-byte I2C burst

main_link_framing.active_video: packed into Transfer Units (TU, typically 32 or 64 symbols/lane; remainder stuffed with Fill)
main_link_framing.blanking_framing: BS (Blanking Start) / BE (Blanking End) control (K) symbols delimit active line data
main_link_framing.secondary_data: SS/SE delimit secondary-data packets (audio sample packets, MSA, VSC SDP / InfoFrames, PSR-setup packets) in the blanking intervals
main_link_framing.msa: Main Stream Attributes once per frame (Mvid/Nvid, Htotal/Vtotal, HSP/HSW, active width/height, MISC0/MISC1)

addressing.space: DPCD register address space (incl. eDP-specific block at 00700h) and the I2C address space for I2C-over-AUX
addressing.note: The Main Link video stream is addressless isochronous data; addressing applies to the AUX/DPCD management plane.

frame_format.main_link: micro-packet stream — Transfer Units of active video framed by BS/BE, MSA per frame, secondary-data packets (incl. PSR setup) in blanking; 8b/10b symbols.
frame_format.aux: Manchester-II request/reply: SYNC + START + (command[4] + address[20] + length) / reply(command[4] + data) + STOP.
frame_format.note: The Main Link clock is embedded (recovered during training); there is no dedicated Main Link clock lane.

psr_control.transport: eDP DPCD over AUX (PSR_ENABLE / PSR_CONFIGURATION / PSR_STATUS / PSR2_ENABLE)
psr_control.remote_frame_buffer: panel-local RFB stores the last frame
psr_control.entry: Source enables PSR, transmits a final frame, quiesces the Main Link; panel latches the RFB and self-refreshes
psr_control.exit: on update / IRQ_HPD, Source re-trains (Fast Link Training) and re-transmits (full frame, or PSR2 selective-update region)
psr_control.psr2_selective_update: only the changed rectangular SU region(s) are re-transmitted into the RFB

backlight_control.transport: eDP backlight DPCD registers over AUX
backlight_control.pwm: panel PWM generator under AUX/DPCD control, or a dedicated backlight PWM pin
